summary: Created a local root CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (RHEL 9) using openssl, installed its certificate into the system trust store via /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors plus update-ca-trust extract, verified trust with `trust list` and an openssl verify against the system bundle, and confirmed end-to-end trust by signing and verifying a test leaf certificate. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and CA state, restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reconnection, confirmed a changed boot_id proving an actual reboot, and re-verified the CA anchor/key/trust status persisted after restart.
actions_performed: Checked OS release and captured baseline boot_id on node1
Generated 4096-bit RSA key for the CA
Created self-signed X.509 root CA cert with CN=OS Comparison Root CA, CA:TRUE basic constraints, valid 10 years
Copied CA cert to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors and ran update-ca-trust extract
Verified CA appears in trust list as an anchor and openssl verify succeeds against system bundle
Issued and verified a test leaf certificate signed by the new CA, confirming end-to-end system trust
Cleaned up temporary leaf cert files
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id and CA trust state
Issued systemctl reboot on node1 with acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until it reconnected after reboot
Confirmed changed boot_id post-restart, proving actual reboot occurred
Verified CA anchor, key, and trust status recovered/persisted after restart

evidence.requirement: Create local CA named 'OS Comparison Root CA'
evidence.summary: Generated CA private key and self-signed cert with subject/issuer CN=OS Comparison Root CA, CA:TRUE, valid 10 years

evidence.requirement: Install CA certificate as trusted system CA
evidence.summary: Copied cert to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors, ran update-ca-trust extract; trust list shows it as an anchor and openssl verify succeeds against the system bundle

evidence.requirement: End-to-end proof the CA is trusted system-wide
evidence.summary: Signed a test leaf cert with the new CA and verified it against the system trust bundle without specifying the CA explicitly
Captured pre-restart boot_id (98aa35f5-...) and confirmed CA trust anchor present and file exists
systemctl reboot issued with immediate acknowledgement; subsequent polls show connection timeout then reset while node was down

evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity proving restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id (c7e930f4-...) differs from pre-restart boot_id (98aa35f5-...), proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of CA trust state
evidence.summary: After reboot, trust list still shows OS Comparison Root CA as an anchor, openssl verify still succeeds, and both the anchor file and CA key file are present
